item.title: Walt Burns Captures Snow-Covered Fort Worth Landmarks [GALLERY]
item.description: Choosing to be responsible and foregoing a drive to check out the snowy scenery? Don't sweat it. Local photog Walt Burns braved the icy conditions to snap some pretty epic pics.

item.title: Gary Patterson’s Next Act Takes Him to USC
item.description: Gary Patterson’s four-decade coaching career enters a new phase with a move from Fort Worth to Los Angeles.

item.title: James Prosek Brings the Prairie to a Rooftop in Fort Worth
item.description: The Yale-educated artist, author, and naturalist revives the native prairie that once defined North Texas with a 300-foot mural atop The Westbrook.

item.title: Locally Owned Stella Jets Flies High on Bravo's ‘Real Housewives’
item.description: With by-the-seat flights, celebrity travel experiences, and a private terminal in Addison, the company is broadening who private aviation is for.

item.title: Fort Worth Hospital Joins Elite Study of Next-Generation Defibrillator
item.description: Texas Health Fort Worth is part of a rare study testing a device that could change how doctors treat dangerous heart rhythms.

item.title: Cattlemen’s Steakhouse Rings in a New Honor: One Onion at a Time
item.description: Something small and unexpected at the Stockyards has earned a rare seal of approval for one of it’s legendary restaurants.

item.title: Student Artists Gain Civic Recognition in Long-Running Fort Worth Exhibition
item.description: The Mayoral High School Art Competition turns ten, elevating high school artists with awards, gallery space, and mayoral recognition.

item.title: Two Promotions Announced at Fort Worth Event Venues
item.description: The city has named a new operations manager at the Fort Worth Convention Center and an interim sales director at Will Rogers Memorial Center.
